page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position the ecs.g6.8xlarge in the average tier for multi-core operations. The stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores both fall within the middle 50% of tested instances. However, single-core performance is a notable tradeoff, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression benchmarks ranking in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the average tier, with read-only large block speeds at 108.04 GB/sec and write speeds at 47.67 GB/sec.

Given its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring steady multi-threaded execution without extreme single-core demands. It is well-suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, static web serving, Redis caching, and multi-threaded data decompression tasks.
